$comment: Source registry. Rights verified July 2026. 'public-domain' = published before 1928 (public domain in the US and, for these works, worldwide). 'reference-only' = modern reconstruction, used to inform our own low-poly work, NOT copied or hosted. Features reference these by id via properties.sources[].

wilson-1865.title: Ordnance Survey of Jerusalem
wilson-1865.creator: Capt. Charles W. Wilson, R.E.
wilson-1865.rightsNote: First scientific survey of Jerusalem (1:2500 / 1:10000). Published 1865–66; public domain.
wilson-1865.holdingInstitution: National Library of Israel; Library of Congress; Huntington Digital Library

illes-relief-1873.title: Illés Relief of Jerusalem (1:500 model)
illes-relief-1873.creator: Stefan Illés
illes-relief-1873.rightsNote: 1:500 relief built for the 1873 Vienna World's Fair, based on the Wilson survey and Conrad Schick's research. The historical model itself is public domain; modern digitizations (Virtual Illés Relief) carry their own terms — reference-only.
illes-relief-1873.holdingInstitution: Historical Museum of Geneva (original); Tower of David Museum

roberts-holy-land-1842.title: The Holy Land, Syria, Idumea, Arabia, Egypt & Nubia (lithographs)
roberts-holy-land-1842.creator: David Roberts, lith. Louis Haghe
roberts-holy-land-1842.rightsNote: 247 lithographs from on-the-spot 1839 drawings. Library of Congress: 'no known restrictions on publication.'
roberts-holy-land-1842.holdingInstitution: Library of Congress; Metropolitan Museum of Art

american-colony-archive.title: American Colony / Matson Photograph Collection
american-colony-archive.creator: American Colony Photo Department (Matson)
american-colony-archive.rightsNote: Library of Congress: 'no known restrictions on publication' for the Matson (G. Eric and Edith Matson) Collection. Confirm per-image; most pre-1928 images are clear.
american-colony-archive.holdingInstitution: Library of Congress, Prints & Photographs Division

bavarian-aerial-1918.title: German (Bavarian) aerial photographs of Jerusalem
bavarian-aerial-1918.creator: Bayerisches Fliegerkorps
bavarian-aerial-1918.rightsNote: WWI-era aerial reconnaissance; pre-1928, public domain. Stereo pairs allow extraction of real building heights for low-poly reconstruction.

osm.title: OpenStreetMap
osm.creator: OpenStreetMap contributors
osm.rightsNote: Open Database License (ODbL). Used for present-day street fabric and base geometry; attribution required.

neighborhood-founding-record.title: Historical record of the founding of Jerusalem's neighborhoods outside the walls
neighborhood-founding-record.creator: Multiple (documentary record)
neighborhood-founding-record.rightsNote: Founding dates of the early neighborhoods are well-established historical facts (deeds, cornerstone records, contemporary press). Exact footprints still require georeferenced digitization.

burgoyne-mamluk-1987.title: Mamluk Jerusalem: An Architectural Study
burgoyne-mamluk-1987.creator: Michael Hamilton Burgoyne
burgoyne-mamluk-1987.rightsNote: Definitive architectural survey of Mamluk buildings. Copyrighted scholarship — used as research reference for typology, not reproduced.
burgoyne-mamluk-1987.holdingInstitution: British School of Archaeology in Jerusalem

madaba-map.title: Madaba Mosaic Map
madaba-map.creator: Unknown (Byzantine mosaicists)
madaba-map.rightsNote: Byzantine floor mosaic depicting Jerusalem with the colonnaded Cardo. Public domain; used as a documented anchor for the Byzantine layer.
